_README: Entra SSO / Workload Identity Federation values (#63).
Copy this file to federation.local.json (gitignored) and fill it in.
vite.main.config.ts bakes it into the main bundle at build time. If the file
is absent the app is simply unconfigured and behaves exactly as it does today
(bring-your-own-key), which is correct for anyone outside the organization.
The registry policy key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\shotAI\Federation overrides
any value here, so IT can correct a rotated rule without a new installer.
None of these is a credential (the Entra JWT is what authenticates), but
together they identify one organization's tenant and Anthropic org, which is
why they are never committed to this public repository.
AudienceAppId must be the BARE app-ID GUID, with no api:// prefix.
ClientAppId is optional: omit it when one registration is both the client and
the audience, which is the deployed topology and what macOS ships.
WorkspaceId is optional; omit it to let a single-workspace rule pick its own.
SupportUrl is optional and must be https. Its host must also be permitted by
the openExternal allowlist in ipc.ts, or the link is silently refused.
